question: What kind of recipient, tested over a fixed period, is alone fit to receive a teaching that has been previously accomplished?
premises: Only a previously accomplished recipient qualifies for transmission of this teaching.
Qualification requires testing over the course of one year.
The act of giving is restricted to such a tested recipient.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: Criteria for passing the year-long test remain unspecified
plain_english: It is to be given only to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
